learningObjectives: Identify trend, seasonality, and noise in time series data.
Understand the basic workflow for time series forecasting.

activities.title: Explore Time Series Components
activities.instruction: Adjust each component and observe the series.

content.concept: Time series can contain trend, seasonality, cyclical behavior, and irregular noise.

activities.title: Map Forecasting Components
activities.instruction: Connect each component to its role.

content.concept: Forecasting uses historical observations and time-dependent patterns to estimate future values.

activities.title: Build a Forecasting Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the forecasting stages in order.

content.concept: A forecasting workflow includes preparing chronological data, exploring patterns, training a model, validating predictions, and forecasting future values.

activities.title: Choose the Forecasting Method
activities.instruction: Select an appropriate approach for each scenario.

content.concept: Forecasting methods should match the structure, frequency, history, and behavior of the time series.
